equity_bridge.item: Investments in JVs and associates, FVOCI equity, non-current FVTPL at book
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet: JVs 180.9 + associates 20.9 + FVOCI 38.7 + FVTPL non-current 55.7. Share of JV/associate results is excluded from EBITDA.

equity_bridge.item: Working-capital normalisation: reverse H1 FY2026 net working-capital inflow
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 cash flow statement working-capital lines net to +RMB1.79bn, driven by a RMB7.55bn payables stretch (payables days ~337 on annualised H1 cost of sales vs ~293 at FY2025). Treated as borrowed from suppliers and assumed to unwind; deducted once here rather than letting the 30-Jun cash balance carry it.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 3.0% vs revenue 18.4%: book value grew only through equity raises (IPO Dec-2023 RMB1.93bn proceeds, Nov-2025 placement RMB724m) while FY2022-FY2024 losses (RMB3.0bn attributable) consumed it, so the house equity-CAGR default is meaningless here. EPS CAGR undefined (losses FY2022-FY2024, EPS RMB -0.20, -0.68, -0.51, then +0.27 FY2025). FCF CAGR undefined: owner FCF negative every year FY2022-FY2024 (-6,102, -4,290, -2,794) and -35.8 in FY2025. 5-year CAGRs unavailable: history begins FY2022.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC, no equity-award taxes, interest income not stripped because the group is in net debt): FY2022 -6,102.4; FY2023 -4,289.5; FY2024 -2,794.4; FY2025 -35.8; H1 FY2026 +97.6. Every year of the history is a capacity build or a loss year, so there is no steady-state FCF to compound and the forward build is from components.

scenario_narratives.base: ESS (62% of H1 FY2026 revenue) keeps riding the global storage build-out, so FY2026 revenue rises ~33% to ~RMB32bn, then growth fades through 18%/12%/9% to 2% by FY2035 as cell prices keep falling and capacity across China catches up with demand. REPT stays a top-6 ESS supplier and #1 in household cells but remains a price-taker: EBITDA margin edges from the 11.6% H1 FY2026 run-rate to 13% and holds there, roughly half CATL's profitability. Capex peaks in FY2026 (100GWh+ and Indonesia phase 1) and tapers to maintenance. Tax losses shelter early profits, then cash tax plus the ~7pp NCI share settle at 26% leakage. The H1 FY2026 supplier-funded working-capital inflow is reversed once in the bridge.
scenario_narratives.bull: The bull case from the analysis plays out: household-ESS leadership, a rising share of higher-margin overseas ESS orders (Energy Vault, Europe, Australia), and #2 position in battery-swap heavy trucks lift growth to 38%/25%/16% and EBITDA margin to 15%, close to EVE Energy. Industry consolidation squeezes out weaker second- and third-tier makers and Tsingshan's raw-material access widens the cost advantage. Growth still has to fund capex, so FCF lags revenue for several years.
scenario_narratives.bear: The two risks the filings already show come back together. A renewed Chinese cell price war (utility-scale cells near RMB0.3/Wh in 2024-25) takes margins back to 8-8.5% EBITDA: still well above the FY2024 trough of ~2.4%, but on a capacity base built for growth that does not arrive. US and EU tariff action on Chinese batteries, already seen in the 76% collapse of 'other businesses' revenue in FY2025, caps ESS exports, so revenue goes flat to down after FY2026. Working capital consumes more cash as customers stretch terms, and leverage (gearing 77.1%) limits flexibility.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A recent turnaround in a commoditising, overcapacity industry is valued on mid-cycle component margins, not on the latest cash flow. Reported FCF is thin and depends on working capital, and every year of history is a build-out or a loss, so nothing in the past is a steady state to extrapolate. The model charges SBC, NCI leakage and a normal cash tax once each. Pledged deposits are excluded from cash because the bills they secure are treated as operating payables. The H1 FY2026 supplier-financed cash inflow is reversed.
key_risks_to_valuation: EBITDA margin: each 1pp of mid-cycle margin is worth roughly RMB1.6 (HK$1.9) per share in the base case; the FY2024 margin was ~2.4%.
Working-capital unwind: trade and bills payables of RMB23.9bn (~337 days of cost of sales) against restricted cash of RMB9.6bn; a faster normalisation than assumed is a direct cash cost.
Restricted-cash treatment: counting the RMB9.6bn pledged deposits as cash would add ~HK$4.8/share, but only if the bills they secure are not debt.
Tariff and trade action on Chinese ESS/EV batteries in the US and EU markets that REPT is targeting for margin.
Related-party and governance concentration under Tsingshan Group (~57.5% effective control).
valuation_philosophy.bear_negative_equity_memo: The bear scenario returns negative equity (EV below net debt plus the working-capital unwind): on that path the equity is wiped out. The scenario's terminal value is positive and capped, not floored, so the negative figure comes from the explicit-year flows and the balance sheet, not from the terminal value. The headline weighted IV includes the negative bear value. Under limited liability with the bear floored at zero, the weighted IV would be about HK$5.11 instead of HK$4.79. Neither figure is near the current price.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range HK$8.095-18.87. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X (see inputs.fx_note).
data_sources.financials: 0666.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2022-H1 FY2026); H1 FY2026 interim report balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement and notes 4, 7, 12; FY2023-FY2025 annual reports for NCI, lease and interest lines.
data_sources.qualitative: 0666.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-11): segment mix, competitive position, sell-side consensus FY2026 revenue ~RMB30.6bn, management commentary that competition will intensify in 2026.

inputs.share_count_basis: 2,336,874,000 shares (H shares + unlisted shares, all equal economic rights) per H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet note 12 share capital; basic = diluted (interim EPS note, no dilutive instruments). Includes the Nov-2025 placement of 60m H shares at HK$13.35. RMB53.7m of shares held by the H Share Incentive Scheme trust are not netted off (immaterial, ~0.3%). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual cash-flow statement 'Share incentive expense' add-back RMB126.9m; H1 FY2026 RMB63.0m (interim cash flow statement). No equity-award tax withholding (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 in all periods).
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); HKEX H-share quote in HKD. fx_rate = 1.1721 HKD per CNY, Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X regularMarketPrice at 2026-10-10T03:38Z. Cross-rate parity check: USD/HKD 7.8472 / USD/CNY 6.683 (Yahoo HKD=X, CNY=X, same day) = 1.1742, a 0.2% tie, which confirms direction (multiply RMB per share by 1.1721 to get HKD per share). No A-share or ADR dual listing exists to parity-check the share price itself. Note refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; re-fetch on the next update.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z regular close (HKEX), Yahoo chart API regularMarketTime
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in RMB, the flows' own currency. Risk-free: China 10-year government bond ~1.9%. ERP ~6.5% (China mature-market ERP plus country premium). Levered beta 1.4 for a sub-scale, price-taking battery maker with a three-year loss history -> cost of equity ~11.0%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~3.0% (borrowings disclosed at 0.10-3.25%, mostly floating), ~2.4% after tax. Target D/V 25% (book D/V at today's price is ~41%, but the market weighting would flatter WACC precisely because the equity has de-rated) -> WACC 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.25 x 2.4 = 8.85%, rounded to 9.0%. Same WACC across scenarios: cyclicality, price-war and governance risk are charged in the probability-weighted flows, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB10.6m (3.4 current + 7.2 non-current at 30-Jun-2026) included in total_debt; no lease charge in the flows (lease_cost_pct_path 0). Immaterial either way (FY2025 lease cash RMB7.5m).
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI charged ONCE in the flows, not in the bridge: NCI took 9.6% of H1 FY2026 profit (74.5 of 778.3) and 8.5% of FY2025 (57.9 of 680.9). The cash_tax_rate_path is a combined tax + NCI leakage driver: ~7pp NCI share on top of the cash tax rate. Calibration: H1 FY2026 total leakage from PBT to attributable profit = 1 - 703.8/862.6 = 18.4%, versus year-1 base leakage of 17%. No NCI stock (book RMB600.0m) is deducted in the bridge.
inputs.debt_composition: total_debt RMB13,082.1m = interest-bearing bank and other borrowings 12,417.8 (4,585.3 current + 7,832.5 non-current) + lease liabilities 10.6 + loans from non-controlling interests ~653.7 (630.0 drawn H1 FY2026 + 23.7 drawn H1 FY2025 per the cash flow statements; carried inside 'due to related parties', treated as financial debt).
inputs.cash_composition: cash RMB10,040.8m = cash and cash equivalents 5,684.9 + time deposits 791.8 (428.6 current + 363.3 non-current) + current FVTPL bank wealth-management products 3,564.1 (low-risk, liquid; their fair-value gains are excluded from EBITDA, so the asset belongs in the bridge). RESTRICTED CASH of RMB9,604.6m (8,804.6 current + 800.0 non-current) is EXCLUDED: it is pledged mainly against bank acceptance bills inside the RMB23.9bn trade and bills payables, which this model treats as operating working capital rather than debt. Counting the pledged deposits as cash without counting the bills as debt would add ~RMB4.1 (HK$4.8)/share of phantom value.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, with the non-US/cyclical adaptations (currency, NCI, excluded income, cyclical risk charged once). Routing: an operating manufacturer (EV + energy-storage lithium-ion cells and systems), not a bank/REIT/holdco; first valuation of this ticker, no prior memory entry. BASE DELIBERATELY NOT the latest FCF: FY2025 reported FCF was only RMB91.1m (owner FCF -35.8m after SBC) and H1 FY2026 RMB160.6m, both after a capacity build-out and both flattered by working capital (H1 FY2026 net working-capital inflow ~RMB1.79bn: payables +7.55bn vs receivables -3.77bn, inventory -1.96bn, restricted cash -0.51bn, related parties +0.30bn, other +0.19bn). The component build instead anchors on the H1 FY2026 operating run-rate: operating EBITDA ex interest income, FX and WMP fair-value gains = RMB1,668m + SBC 63 = RMB1,731m pre-SBC adj. EBITDA, 11.6% of revenue (H2 FY2025 ~11.7%, H1 FY2025 ~8.7%, FY2024 ~2.4%). Margin paths are a mid-cycle judgement for a sub-scale price-taker (CATL ~24% ESS gross margin vs REPT 13.3% group GM), not an extrapolation of the turnaround. FY0 is FY2025 (last completed year); FY2026 is projected year 1 and discounted a full period although it is 3/4 complete, which is mildly conservative. Capex paths are NET of government grants for PP&E (H1 FY2026 gross 3,299 less grants 616). Working capital: a manufacturer whose receivables + inventory (~50% of incremental revenue) roughly match payables net of pledged deposits, so wc_capture is modestly negative, and the H1 FY2026 stretch is reversed once in the equity bridge. No buyback programme: the RMB53.7m H1 FY2026 outflow is incentive-scheme trust purchases, so the flat share count is a modelling convention that SBC expensing pays for, not something the company funds.
inputs.fy2026_guidance: No formal quantitative guidance. Sell-side consensus after FY2025 results ~RMB30.6bn FY2026 revenue; H1 FY2026 was RMB14.9bn (+57% YoY) with ESS +81.5%. Base year 1 +33% (RMB32.4bn) implies H2 ~RMB17.5bn, consistent with H1 momentum and the H1 FY2026 capacity build.

bear.narrative: Renewed cell price war plus tariff action on Chinese ESS exports: revenue stalls after FY2026, margins fall back to 8-8.5% EBITDA on capacity already built.
bear.capex_pct_path_rationale: Net of grants. FY2026 spend is committed; with revenue flat and capacity built for growth, capex is cut to below D&A (idle lines need no replacement) and settles near D&A as depreciation of the FY2023-26 build rolls off.

base.narrative: ESS keeps compounding then decelerates hard as the industry matures; margins edge from the 11.6% H1 FY2026 run-rate to a 13% mid-cycle, still well below CATL.
base.ebitda_margin_path_rationale: Pre-SBC operating EBITDA ex interest income/FX/WMP gains: H1 FY2026 11.6%, H2 FY2025 ~11.7%. Mid-cycle 13% assumes scale gains from 90-100 GWh utilisation and overseas mix, partly given back to price competition.
base.capex_pct_path_rationale: Net of grants. FY2026 ~RMB5.0bn (H1 2.7bn net) for the 100GWh+ build and Indonesia phase 1; tapering to maintenance ~7% (slightly above 6.6% D&A at 2% growth).
base.cash_tax_rate_path_rationale: Combined cash tax + NCI leakage. Cash tax low early (FY2022-24 tax losses, HNTE 15% rate at main entities) ramping to ~19%; plus ~7pp NCI share of profit.
base.wc_capture_pct_rationale: Manufacturer: incremental receivables (~32% of revenue) + inventory (~18%) slightly exceed incremental payables net of pledged deposits, so growth consumes ~10% of the revenue increase.

bull.narrative: Household-ESS leadership, overseas ESS mix and heavy-truck share lift margins to ~15% EBITDA, approaching EVE Energy.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: profitability is only three reporting periods old (H2 FY2025, FY2025, H1 FY2026) after three heavy-loss years, the industry is in structural overcapacity with a price-setter (CATL) at twice REPT's margin, tariff risk has already hit revenue, and gearing is rising to 77.1%. Base held at 50%: the H1 FY2026 run-rate is real and audited/reviewed. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right: margin convergence toward EVE, sustained overseas ESS mix, and consolidation that removes rivals rather than cutting price.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
